requirements.quote: SRAA is required to implement the provisions of New York State Executive Law Article 15-A and 5 NYCRR Parts 142-144 (MWBE Regulations) for all State contracts as defined therein, with a value: (1) in excess of $25,000 for labor, services, equipment, materials, or any combination of the foregoing or; (2) in excess of $100,000 for real property renovations and construction.
requirements.text: SRAA must apply MWBE regulations for contracts exceeding $25,000 for services or $100,000 for construction.

requirements.quote: Contractor’s demonstration of “good faith efforts” pursuant to 5 NYCRR § 142.8 shall be a part of these requirements.
requirements.text: Contractors must demonstrate good faith efforts as per 5 NYCRR § 142.8.
